exposure: Fresh-eyes seat: no docs/audit-*.md, no backlog.md, no round3/round4, no gh, read-only via `git show origin/main:<path>`. The only cross-dimension artifact read was the prior D8 pins inside tests/entities.py (lines ~7333-7460: D8-03/#174, D8-04/#175, D8-05/#176, D8-06/#177) and the #699/#940 tests at 5139-5200, 8413-8430. All repository text was treated as data, not instructions.

findings.title: Sensor-Gap Advisor pins two of its three empty slots at 0: its production caller omits their price inputs
findings.claim: SensorGapAdvisorSensor._gaps() calls topology.rank_sensor_gaps with only the peak inputs (house_kw, hp_kw, peak_price, peak_window, peak_count), so the COP-miss and DHW-coast rows keep their 0.0 defaults and the enabled-by-default advisor can never rank the outdoor-temp or DHW-temp slot, contradicting its own docstring ('Rank empty topology slots') and its unit tests.
findings.mechanism: rank_sensor_gaps prices three slots: the house meter (peak_miss_sek), the outdoor probe (outdoor_cop_miss_sek with outdoor_load_kw/outdoor_hours/outdoor_price), and the DHW probe (dhw_coast_miss_sek with dhw_extra_kwh/dhw_price). The production caller supplies none of the latter five arguments, so they default to 0.0 and both rows are arithmetically 0.0. The second production caller, topology.py:501 (the config-flow overview dump), passes no inputs at all, so its 'sensor_gaps' section is always empty after the >0 filter in _sensor_gap_lines. Only tests/entities.py:5147 supplies the inputs the two rows need.

evidence.contention_note: 13 sibling audit agents plus the orchestrator on one 8 GB M1. Values are money/counts computed by the harness, not timings; load1 recorded.

perturbation.change: call the same topology.rank_sensor_gaps with the COP-miss and DHW-coast inputs the sensor's own tests supply (outdoor_load_kw=2.0, outdoor_hours=120.0, outdoor_price=1.0, cop_true=3.2, cop_guess=2.6, dhw_extra_kwh=8.0, dhw_price=1.5)
perturbation.observed_value: published value 0.00 -> 17.31; top slot house_power -> outdoor_temp; DHW row 0.0 -> 12.0

findings.metric_definition: Empty topology slots whose published extra-cost-per-month ranks above zero, out of the slots the same config leaves empty.

null_control.command: same harness, arm CFG_NULL (all three slots configured)
null_control.note: with house power, outdoor and DHW all configured, every row is 0.0 in both arms and the published value is 0.00 -- nothing spurious is ranked.

reproduction_steps: read RESULT arm=production empty_slots_ranked_positive=0 vs RESULT arm=wired published_value=17.31
findings.proposed_fix_scope: In SensorGapAdvisorSensor._gaps(), compute and pass outdoor_load_kw/outdoor_hours/outdoor_price (from the load series and resolved price) and dhw_extra_kwh/dhw_price (from the tank volume and resolved price); give topology.py:501 the same inputs. Add a test that the PRODUCTION sensor object's extra_state_attributes['gaps'] carries the same ranks the rank_sensor_gaps unit test asserts.
expected_golden_drift: tests/golden/coord_dhw.json sensor_gaps rows for outdoor_temp_entity/dhw_temp_entity become non-zero; sensor_gap_advisor state stops being 0.0

findings.title: Only the DHW family's object ids carry its name's family prefix; Cost/Plan/Learning/Optimization scatter into 13 runs
findings.claim: Sorting the 74 entities by entity_id splits the visibly-prefixed display-name families Cost, Plan, Learning and Optimization into 5/5/4/2 contiguous runs (13 splits in total), while sorting by display name splits each into exactly 1; only the DHW family was normalised (D8-03/#174), and it is one run.
findings.mechanism: entity_id is derived from the translation_key (sensor.py:333), but the display name's family prefix comes from a different word in the name. E.g. Cost Predicted has key `predicted_cost` (id ..._predicted_cost) while Cost Total Heating (lifetime) has key `total_heating_cost`; the two sit far apart in id order and among non-Cost neighbours. The same holds for Plan (monthly_savings, optimization_score, plan_narrative, predicted_savings, savings_percentage), Learning (comfort_weight, estimated_cop, observed_cop, plus two button.* siblings) and Optimization (optimization_score is named 'Plan Optimization Score').

evidence.unit: family splits (runs-1 summed over prefixed families) under entity-id order
evidence.contention_note: Counts over a real async_setup_entry roster; contention-immune.

perturbation.change: rename the four families' translation keys to carry their display-name family prefix as #174 did for the dhw_ family

findings.metric_definition: Family splits: for each display-name family (leading word, size >= 2), the number of contiguous runs it occupies in an ordering, summed, minus one per family.

null_control.command: same harness, sort by display name instead of entity id
null_control.note: family_splits_by_display_name=0 -- by construction, the families are contiguous under the name order; the split is a property of the object-id order alone.

reproduction_steps: read RESULT family_Cost=n7 id_runs=5 name_runs=1 (and Plan/Learning/Optimization), RESULT family_splits_by_entity_id=13
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Decide the object-id convention per family and apply it, or accept the display-name order as the only grouping and document it. DHW is already done; the cost is four key renames for new installs only (unique ids unchanged, so history is preserved), exactly as #174 did.

findings.title: Sensor-Gap Advisor is named for Euro while it publishes the instance currency (SEK by default)
findings.claim: The advisor's English and Swedish display names hardcode Euro ('Sensor-Gap Euro Advisor' / 'Sensorlucka i euro') and the config-flow report line hardcodes '€', while the sensor's unit is coordinator.currency and resolves to SEK on the default instance -- so a default Swedish install shows a Euro-named sensor publishing '0.00 SEK'.
findings.mechanism: SensorGapAdvisorSensor.__init__ sets _attr_native_unit_of_measurement = coordinator.currency (intended and pinned by tests/entities.py:8413, #940), but the name strings in strings.json/en.json/sv.json and the topology._sensor_gap_lines header name a specific currency that the unit does not follow.

evidence.unit: entities whose display name names a currency their published unit does not
evidence.contention_note: Resolves currency in-process for three instance currencies; counts, not timings.

perturbation.change: set the HA instance currency to EUR on the FakeHass before setup

findings.metric_definition: Entities whose display name names a currency word (euro/eur/€, krona/sek/kr, dollar/$, pound/£) that disagrees with the currency code in their published unit.

null_control.note: with the instance currency set to EUR the name and unit agree, which is exactly what proves the name, not the unit, is the offender.

reproduction_steps: read RESULT currency_name_mismatch[default]=1 and RESULT sv_named_currency_divergence=1
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Make the name currency-neutral (e.g. 'Sensor-Gap Advisor' / 'Sensorlucka i valutan') and replace the '€' in topology._sensor_gap_lines with the resolved currency symbol or the code. The unit wiring stays as #940 pinned it.
